name: ryu.no-ai-slop
description: Bundles the `no-ai-slop` editing skill and runs it on every finished answer: a separate reviewer with a fresh context reads the reply, names the AI-slop patterns it finds, and the agent rewrites the answer to fix them. One pass by default, configurable up to twelve, or set to 0 and trigger it by hand from the composer '+' menu. A clean answer is left alone silently.
